title: TrackWindow
description: Payload: a per-track summary of one window of frames (S9): the best frame in the window, how sharp it is, and the spine's pose in it. Written per window, never per frame. Ledger rules: the best frame lies inside the window, and startFrame is not after endFrame.

windowIndex.description: 0 for the track's first window, then counting up.

frameCount.description: Frames of this track seen in the window.

bestFrame.description: The window's best frame for reading the spine. The frame is not kept (INV-22); the hash identifies it.

sharpness.description: Variance of the Laplacian over the spine's quad; higher is sharper. Comparable within a session only.
